verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that integrations can subscribe to real-time page and property change events through webhooks, with Notion sending an HTTP POST on each change. That gives server-side push notification, which an engineer could use to propagate teammates' changes, but it is not live sync inside open Notion sessions. Missing for 10: any documentation of in-app real-time multiplayer sync or live presence across open sessions, evidence that changes appear without refreshing, and hands-on or independent corroboration of live collaboration latency.
